references.role: Main centered original painted base character used only as identity/style reference; neighboring fragments and preview background ignored.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent 4-by-4 animation sprite sheet for Crown & Kingdoms, a hand-painted medieval isometric RTS. Reference image is character identity/style only: use ONLY the main centered character; ignore any neighboring fragments at top and the preview background. Generate 1536x1024 landscape canvas, strict 4 columns by 4 rows, sixteen full-body poses, one complete connected character in each equal cell, same fixed 3/4 isometric view facing right, upper-left lighting, realistic painted cloth and equipment, blue team cloth for recolouring. Transparent background, no labels, grid or terrain. Generous empty margins inside every cell; ENTIRE headgear, weapon, hands, both boots and shadows inside cells, no clipping or neighboring fragments. Consistent head/body/weapon proportions, same person/clothing every frame, readable at 46-pixel body height. Top two rows left-to-right (frames 0-7): eight distinct sequential walking gait poses with alternating feet, planted feet and stepping knees, holding weapon safely. Bottom two rows left-to-right (frames 8-15): eight sequential weapon action poses; frame 8 is a clear ready aiming stance suitable for idle. Frame 12 is the firing/release instant; frames 13-15 recovery/loading, then the sequence loops to frames 8-11 ready/aim/load preparation. Avoid any giant muzzle blast obscuring the figure, duplicated limbs, detached hands, deformed weapons, unreadable silhouette, pixel art or icon styling. Preserve a complete coherent connected body in every pose, with a tiny soft transparent ground shadow. Character: Ottoman Janissary matching the reference: tall white folded felt Janissary cap with red ornament, warm skin and dark moustache, vivid blue long coat over red garments, leather belt and cartridge pouches, brown boots, a long wood-stock early matchlock musket with one straight metal barrel. Walk with both hands holding the musket. Action frames show aiming, small restrained muzzle smoke at frame12, lowering the gun, loading powder/ramrod while keeping the musket and both hands visually attached, recovering and shouldering. No shield, sword, crossbow, modern rifle or extra weapons.
